text:
Turn the files that change under one folder into messages. Watches a directory the node owner allows, tells each subscribed agent what was created, changed or deleted, and marks a file done only after that agent confirms it. Start with help, then status.
status: Mode and any fallback, files tracked, each subscriber's progress, the last scan, the state size against its cap, files skipped for RAG, and a paused guard.; returns: {mode,effective_mode,fallback,tracked,last_scan,skipped,state_bytes,state_max,subscribers,paused,skipped_for_rag}; role: read|write
scan [confirm:true]: Walk the folder now and send what changed. confirm:true (Owners and Maintainers) releases a held mass delete after you have checked the folder.; returns: {seen,created_or_changed,deleted,held,skipped,capped}; role: read|write
  confirm (bool): true releases a paused mass-delete guard; Owners and Maintainers only
reset confirm:true: Forget every tracked file and every confirmed mark, keeping the subscriptions, so each subscriber is sent every file again. Pending deletes are lost. Owners and Maintainers only; a damaged state file is replaced and its subscriptions are lost with it.; returns: {reset}; role: owner|maintainer
  confirm (bool): must be true
sub add <target> [/regex/] [as rag [<namespace> [<table>]]] [replay:false] [bigfile:true]: Send each change under the folder to a queue or an agent's inbox, and send it again until the target confirms it. The files that already exist are sent first unless replay:false. `as rag` sends RAG's own upsert and delete calls.; returns: {id,target,selector,created_by,created_at,sent,confirmed,dropped}; role: read|write
  target (string): Destination queue or agent; the creator's grants are checked at add and before every send
  pattern (string): Portable /pattern/imsu regex on the relative path, at most 200 characters
  rag (bool): true: send RAG's upsert and delete calls
  namespace (string): RAG namespace
  table (string): RAG table
  replay (bool): false: send only later changes
  bigfile (bool): reserved: send a file over the inline limit as a bigfile
sub list: List your subscriptions with sent, confirmed, dropped and pending counts; Owners and Maintainers see all.; returns: {subscriptions:[{id,target,selector,created_by,created_at,sent,confirmed,dropped,pending}]}; role: read|write
sub delete <id>: Remove one subscription and its marks. The creator, or an Owner or Maintainer, may do it.; returns: {deleted}; role: read|write
  id (string): The id from sub add or sub list

json.description: Turn the files that change under one folder into messages. Watches a directory the node owner allows, tells each subscribed agent what was created, changed or deleted, and marks a file done only after that agent confirms it. Start with help, then status.
json.author: Sergey Porfiriev

help.help: Find available methods and their limits.

status.help: Mode and any fallback, files tracked, each subscriber's progress, the last scan, the state size against its cap, files skipped for RAG, and a paused guard.

scan.help: Walk the folder now and send what changed. confirm:true (Owners and Maintainers) releases a held mass delete after you have checked the folder.

args.name: confirm
args.help: true releases a paused mass-delete guard; Owners and Maintainers only

reset.help: Forget every tracked file and every confirmed mark, keeping the subscriptions, so each subscriber is sent every file again. Pending deletes are lost. Owners and Maintainers only; a damaged state file is replaced and its subscriptions are lost with it.

sub.add.help: Send each change under the folder to a queue or an agent's inbox, and send it again until the target confirms it. The files that already exist are sent first unless replay:false. `as rag` sends RAG's own upsert and delete calls.

args.name: target
args.help: Destination queue or agent; the creator's grants are checked at add and before every send

args.name: pattern
args.help: Portable /pattern/imsu regex on the relative path, at most 200 characters

args.name: rag
args.help: true: send RAG's upsert and delete calls

args.name: bigfile
args.help: reserved: send a file over the inline limit as a bigfile

sub.list.help: List your subscriptions with sent, confirmed, dropped and pending counts; Owners and Maintainers see all.

sub.delete.help: Remove one subscription and its marks. The creator, or an Owner or Maintainer, may do it.

args.name: id
args.help: The id from sub add or sub list

dir.help: The folder to watch, an absolute path inside a root the node owner listed for this agent (runner agents.json, roots); only its checked real path is used

include.help: Globs on the relative path; default all files

exclude.help: Globs on the relative path; exclude wins; default dotfiles and dot directories

every.help: Poll interval such as 30m; default 30m in both and 5m in poll

settle.help: How long a file must stay quiet before it is sent, such as 5s; default none

batch.help: Changes sent per round to one subscriber, 1..500

max_file_size.help: Inline limit: a larger file is sent as size and hash only, never cut

max_per_scan.help: Creates and changes taken per scan; the rest wait, 1..100000

baseline.help: true records the files that exist at the first scan without sending them, and sub add does not replay

delete_pct.help: Mass-delete guard: more than this share of tracked files in one pass pauses deletes

delete_max.help: Mass-delete guard: more than this many deletes in one pass pauses them
